name: Freelance Knight
author: Johan Markström
description: Freelancers, or “robber knights,” are fallen nobles with little to their name but their weapons and armour. Drunk and bitter, they haunt the surrounding settlements for work, caring more for coin than honour.

abilities.name: Duelist
abilities.text: Once per battle round, this fighter can make the 'Counter' reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

abilities.name: Heckle
abilities.text: Select (X/2) enemy fighters that are within 6" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, when making attack actions, those fighters must subtract 3 from their Fight and Shoot characteristics, unless those attack actions target this fighter.
